Setup Failure.root_cause_hint: Truth run setup or Playwright runner did not produce stable browser evidence.

Selector Failure.root_cause_hint: Expected UI contract is not visible; selector may be stale or the page renders a different state.

Auth Failure.root_cause_hint: Auth bootstrap, session state, login redirect, or auth error handling blocks protected screens.

Workspace Failure.root_cause_hint: Workspace membership or active workspace bootstrap prevents AppShell/documents readiness.

API Failure.root_cause_hint: Frontend observed API, health, fetch, or HTTP failure evidence.

Routing Failure.root_cause_hint: Route guard or redirect behavior does not land on the expected page.

Timeout Failure.root_cause_hint: Tests wait until timeout, usually as a cascade after an earlier state transition failure.

Test Data Missing.root_cause_hint: Seeded truth data or expected test fixture state is missing or not visible.
